name: TITAN COMPACT OPEN: Augmented Team Combat S22
description: By Season 22, the TITAN COMPACT has evolved into the most-watched team combat league in GLMZ, featuring five-person squads with unrestricted augmentation budgets competing in structured elimination matches inside purpose-built combat arenas with dynamic terrain that shifts between rounds. Corporate team ownership is mandatory — no independent teams have competed since Season 14. Each corponation fields a squad augmented to its own proprietary specifications, making the matches as much a demonstration of corporate augmentation philosophy as athletic competition.
story_hooks: A TITAN COMPACT athlete discovers that her team's augmentation package includes monitoring hardware that transmits her biometric and location data to corporate security — not just during matches, but continuously.

Dario Ferreira-Nkosi, released after fourteen months in corporate detention for a sabotage he didn't commit, is looking for someone willing to help him prove it — and the evidence trail leads somewhere no one wants it to go.

A Tier 1 teenager who has followed TITAN COMPACT her whole life gets access to a corporate training facility through a scholarship program and realizes the gap between the marketed fantasy of augmented sport and the reality of what it costs the athletes is wider than she ever imagined.
